sources.title: clef (Cloudflare) · Cloudflare AI docs · Cloudflare Workers AI docs
sources.snippet: Clef is a 27B multimodal decision model that turns a state and a schema of typed questions into decisions. It reads the state as text, JSON, images, or video, and returns a probability for every allowed option of every question.

sources.snippet: We are introducing Clef and Clef-flash, open-source decision models hosted on Workers AI for high-speed classification and agentic workflows. Also launching: a new reinforcement learning platform that allows developers to fine-tune decision models using their own data.

sources.title: Introducing Clef: Cloudflare's first open-source decision models, now ...
sources.snippet: Clef and Clef-flash, the first models trained by the Cloudflare Workers AI team, are decision models that return typed answers with probabilities. They lead 7 of 10 decision benchmarks, run up to 13x faster than Jev, and are open source under Apache 2.0.
